trailheads.name: Tahoma Creek trail (Tahoma Glacier alternative)

Round Pass about 3.8 mi past Dry Creek (via search summary; not fetched directly).

statusSentence: As of late October 2026 Westside Road is open to vehicles only as far as the Dry Creek barricade about 3 miles in, and beyond it the road stays closed to cars, open to walkers and bikes, with no date for reopening.

closurePoint: Road 34 spur (off FR 32 at mile 1.4 from the Shuksan picnic area) ends at the Ruth Creek washout, about 2.3-2.4 mi from the highway; no current Forest Service closure alert on FR 32 itself
reopening: None needed for the lower road (open to the washout). The washout is a long-standing end of the drivable road; a 2024 decision approved a bypass at the end of FSR 32 for Hannegan Pass trailhead access, which is a different washout from Ruth Creek.

trailheads.name: Nooksack Cirque trailhead (original, 2,550 ft)

sources.says: No closure alert on Road 32; Road 34 runs about a flat mile to its terminus at Ruth Creek (Nooksack Cirque trailhead); road 32 passes Goat Mountain trailhead.

disagreements: The Ruth Creek washout (Road 34) and the Hannegan Pass washout (end of FR 32) are different places; the Nooksack Tower routes concern the former. No 2026 trip report found confirming the Ruth Creek parking is still passable.
statusSentence: As of late October 2026 the Forest Service lists no closure on the Hannegan Pass road, but the Nooksack Cirque spur has long ended at the Ruth Creek washout, from which the old roadbed is walked about 2 miles to the trailhead.
